root_cause_conclusion: The 32 structure events are not dominated by finish_reason=length. They split into 29 schema/content-shape failures from the single parseable response and 3 requests with no usable JSON or usage. The old runner also failed to persist finish_reason and raw output, so exact parse-versus-timeout separation for those three requests is unavailable; their 900-second deltas match the configured request timeout.
